details: Malicious package. A postinstall hook runs `node postinstall.js`, which reads cloud and developer credentials (`~/.aws/config`, `~/.aws/credentials`, `~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json`, `~/.docker/config.json`, `~/.git-credentials`), runs host reconnaissance (`ps aux`, `whoami`, `id`, `uname -a`) and connects to the bare IP 69.42.222.23. Observed in a sandboxed install. The name targets users of the MEXC crypto exchange; the package has no repository or README. Published 2026-03-24 and unpublished from npm on 2026-03-27.
